status: Proposed interface; original illustrative design, not a device capture or qualified recording result.
flow: REC opens empty-pad chooser; pad chooses destination without sounding; REC starts; REC stops and saves; EXIT cancels chooser.

states.note: Show current-bank empty pads from a checked snapshot. Occupied or unknown pads are unavailable. A destination press is consumed and must not reach the synth note handler.
The pad is selected before the request owner arms recording. Validate it again when REC starts. The displayed A01 is an illustrative destination.

Bounded manual take: no count-in, REC stops earlier, maximum 120 seconds. Display actual accepted elapsed time against the 120-second cap and progress from accepted frames, not predicted timing. Pads return to normal synth-note delivery after recording starts. The linked scope is an original illustrative waveform; runtime must use a complete owned PCM snapshot.
REC stop requests the checked save to the chosen pad. Stay busy until the native sample/project result is confirmed; error or incomplete save must not show success.

ownership.implementation: Compact recording worker owns control state, destination validation, panel hooks and recorder lifecycle.
ownership.availablePads: Use an authenticated current project/bank cache snapshot and refuse occupied, stale or unknown destinations.
ownership.selection: Destination pad-down and release are consumed by chooser state. No synth note or capture start occurs until the next explicit REC.
ownership.save: A separate REC after start stops and saves. Render success only after confirmed native write and project retirement.
ownership.evidence: Penpot source and shared state geometry describe the intended interface. No recording, timing or memory qualification is implied.
